title: Notification API ownership
body: The notification API ownership is currently unresolved between mobile platform and backend platform teams. The kickoff needs a named API contract owner before mobile alert implementation starts.

title: Notification QA regression checklist
body: Regression checklist indicates prior failures on notification preferences, onboarding edge cases, multi-pet account switching, and push permission recovery flows.

title: Q3 launch milestones
body: Q3 includes discovery, beta, and GA gates for pet health alerts. Support readiness and mobile telemetry severity thresholds must be signed off before beta.

title: Health alert support playbook
body: Support needs help-center copy, escalation macros, severity definitions, and a rollback contact before proactive health alerts are exposed to customers.

title: Mobile alert dependency map
body: Alert delivery depends on telemetry schema freeze, backend threshold service, mobile notification settings, QA matrix approval, and support playbook updates.

title: Launch date compression risk
body: The revised launch date removes two weeks from beta hardening. QA capacity is fixed for the current sprint and regression automation is not complete.

title: Compressed launch messaging plan
body: GTM launch messaging depends on final beta scope, pricing language, customer proof points, and support-approved known limitations before launch approval.

title: Beta and GA release gates
body: Beta exit requires no Sev1 defects, launch-readiness signoff, owner map completion, and a release checklist accepted by engineering, QA, GTM, and TPM.

title: Legacy service migration architecture
body: Legacy service migration remains blocked by fragmented subsystem ownership, incomplete traffic shadowing metrics, and unclear rollback responsibility.

title: Migration privacy and permissions review
body: Security and privacy review must confirm service-to-service permissions, data retention behavior, audit logging, and customer data access before migration kickoff.

title: Migration escalation readiness
body: Support escalation playbook is not yet updated for the migration path. Tier 2 needs rollback language, incident routing, and customer-facing status copy.

title: Migration sequencing plan
body: The phased migration plan requires owners for account service, notification service, billing adapter, traffic ramp, incident lead, and weekly cross-team checkpoints.

title: Alert UX edge cases
body: Design review identifies unresolved empty states, muted-alert copy, severity explanation, first-run education, and accessibility labels for mobile health alerts.

title: Notification preference incident retrospective
body: Prior notification preference migration caused delayed push delivery and customer confusion because rollout ownership and support escalation paths were unclear.

title: Health telemetry privacy notes
body: Health telemetry alerts must avoid exposing sensitive inference details in push notifications and require privacy review for severity thresholds and retention.
